judge.rationale: The candidate never actually modified `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.ts` to move `beforeSession` inside the `try` block, so the core bug remains unfixed and the newly added test will fail. Additionally, the candidate omitted the required `CHANGELOG.md` update and left a scratch `.lore/dod.md` file in the diff. Instead of adding the test to the existing `src/orchestration/chatOrchestrator.test.ts` suite like the reference, it created a separate acceptance test file. The only part of the ticket the candidate actually delivered was the documentation update in `specs/hal-engine-config-hooks/spec.md` and a test case definition.
